about: Image-generated surface textures. Each sheet is one 1:1 image holding a 3x3 grid of nine textures (row by row). materials: world material ids that use the texture (the first texture listed for a material is its default; buildings pick among all of them). meters: real-world width of one tile. tint: 0 keeps the photo's colors, 1 keeps only its light and shade and takes the color of each building. roughness: base microsurface roughness. relief: bump strength in meters.
